boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase, under-21-safe ways for Randolph-Macon students to spend time together on campus.

cards.title: Fridays After Five
cards.subtitle: Campus events after 5 p.m. on Fridays
cards.notes: Check the BUZZ before Friday, then bring a friend to the listed campus program. Events vary by sponsoring group and semester.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Friday-night campus-events series for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Randolph-Macon describes Fridays After Five as free events for students on Friday nights after 5 p.m. during fall and spring semesters.
cards.access_notes: For Randolph-Macon students; check the BUZZ for the current semester’s schedule.

cards.title: Late Night Brock
cards.subtitle: Brock Commons, Saturday nights
cards.notes: Meet at Brock Commons for the current Late Night Brock program, then check the BUZZ if you want to attend or help host.
cards.short_summary: Saturday-night social programming at Brock Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Randolph-Macon states that Late Night Brock is free programming for students and is held Saturday nights during fall and spring semesters.
cards.access_notes: For Randolph-Macon students; held 10 p.m.–midnight on Saturday nights during fall and spring semesters.

cards.title: Brock Rocks Yoga
cards.subtitle: Brock Center Aerobics Room
cards.notes: Choose a listed yoga session, arrive ready to move, and invite a classmate to join. Non-credit participants may drop in for fun.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost group yoga class at the Brock Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brock Rocks program offers free fitness classes to Randolph-Macon students, and its schedule includes Yoga.
cards.access_notes: For students, employees, and retirees; consult the posted Brock Rocks schedule before going.

cards.title: Brock Rocks Guided Meditation
cards.subtitle: Brock Center Aerobics Room
cards.notes: Use the current Brock Rocks schedule to find Guided Meditation, then drop in with a friend for a quiet, instructor-led reset.
cards.short_summary: An instructor-led guided-meditation option in the fitness-class program.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brock Rocks program offers free fitness classes to Randolph-Macon students, and its schedule includes Guided Meditation.
cards.access_notes: For students, employees, and retirees; confirm the current class schedule before attending.

cards.title: Brock Rocks Zumba
cards.subtitle: Brock Center Aerobics Room
cards.notes: Find Zumba on the current class schedule and join the group session with a friend. The program welcomes drop-ins for fun.
cards.short_summary: A free group-dance fitness class for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brock Rocks program offers free fitness classes to Randolph-Macon students, and its schedule includes Zumba.
cards.access_notes: For students, employees, and retirees; consult the current Brock Rocks schedule.

cards.title: Student Leadership Conference
cards.subtitle: Randolph-Macon College campus
cards.notes: Watch Student Engagement announcements for the annual conference, then attend a keynote or leadership track with your student organization.
cards.short_summary: A campus conference with leadership sessions for RMC students.
cards.evidence_claim: Randolph-Macon says its Annual Student Leadership Conference is free to all students who wish to attend.
cards.access_notes: For Randolph-Macon students; offered yearly by the Student Engagement Center.

cards.title: Meet for Group Study
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library
cards.notes: Pick a research question or reading assignment, reserve time with friends, and use the library’s study and collaboration space together.
cards.short_summary: A campus library space for collaborative academic time.
cards.evidence_claim: McGraw-Page Library provides space for research, study, and collaboration, with its described services free of charge to all students.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Student access; library services are available on demand or by appointment.

cards.title: Set Up a Study Session
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library
cards.notes: Coordinate a focused session in the Abernathy Room, bring course materials, and use the round-the-clock study space for a shared work block.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 study room inside McGraw-Page Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The RMC catalog identifies the Abernathy Room as a 24/7 study space in McGraw-Page Library, whose described services are free to students.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Student study space with 24/7 access as stated in the catalog.

cards.title: Use the Evening Study Space
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library
cards.notes: Plan an evening or weekend work session in the Rives Childs Room and check local library guidance before relying on the room.
cards.short_summary: An evening and weekend student-study room in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The RMC catalog states that the Rives Childs Room is available evenings and weekends as a student study space, and described library services are free to students.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Student study space; availability is evenings and weekends according to the catalog.

cards.title: Pick a Book Together
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library, first floor
cards.notes: Browse the POP shelves with a friend, choose a title to discuss, and ask library staff if you need help locating a selection.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor popular-reading collection at McGraw-Page Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The RMC catalog lists the Popular Reading (POP) collection on McGraw-Page Library’s first floor and says described library services are free to all students.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: For Randolph-Macon students; ask library staff about borrowing and current access procedures.
